scripts.setup:venv: test -d python/.venv || python3 -m venv python/.venv && python/.venv/bin/pip install -r python/requirements.txt -r python/requirements-dev.txt || python/.venv/bin/pip install -r python/requirements.txt -r python/requirements-dev.txt -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple --trusted-host pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn
scripts.dev: npm run setup:venv && concurrently -n svc,fe,doc -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev:service" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run docs:dev"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -n svc,fe,tauri -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:service" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run desktop:dev"
scripts.install:all: cd service && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../tauri && npm install && cd .. && npm run setup:venv && npm run setup:precommit
scripts.test: cd service && npm test && cd ../frontend && npx vue-tsc --noEmit && npm test
scripts.test:frontend: cd frontend && npx vue-tsc --noEmit && npm test
